of.needed: whether tracing is enabled and configured to use OTEL propagation standards

consequence.statement: The new OTEL_PROPAGATORS environment variable provides an additional standard way to configure tracing propagation without affecting existing tracing configurations.

assertion.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 adds support for the OTEL_PROPAGATORS environment variable to configure OpenTelemetry tracing propagation.
